name: Progus Store Locator Map (No API Key Required)
author: progus

sections.description:
Progus Store Locator lets you add a store or dealer locator to your WordPress site instantly — no API key required. Display your locations on an interactive, customizable map and help customers find nearby stores right after installation.

Key Features:

  • No API key required — works out of the box right after installation.
  • 5 map providers to choose from — Progus Maps, Apple Maps, OpenStreetMap, Google Maps, Mapbox.
  • 23,000+ map styles available — match the map design perfectly to your brand.
  • IP & browser geolocation — automatically show users the nearest locations.
  • Translated to 130+ languages — fully localized for global audiences.
  • 100% customizable — edit text, fonts, colors, layout, add custom CSS.
  • Custom marker creator — design unique map pins and markers.
  • Shows locations nearby — helps customers find the closest store or dealer.
  • Advanced analytics — track views, searches, and user interactions.
  • Powerful bulk import & Google Sheets sync — easily manage large location databases.
  • Location tags — categorize and filter locations for better user experience.

Pricing

Progus Store Locator includes all features for free with a limited number of store locations.
If you need to add more locations, you can upgrade to a paid plan.

Learn more about available plans: https://progus.com/pages/progus-store-locator-wordpress-pricing

Service Integration:

This plugin connects to the Progus Store Locator service (SaaS) to provide store location data and mapping functionality. Upon activation, the plugin automatically registers your site with the Progus service.

External Service Dependencies:

This plugin relies on the following external services:

  • Progus API — https://sl-app.proguscommerce.com/api/wp (registration, auth, management).
  • Progus Widget (Map) — https://sl-widget.proguscommerce.com/main (embed map via iframe).
  • Progus Dealer Form — https://sl-form.proguscommerce.com/main (embed dealer form via iframe).
  • Progus Panel — https://storelocator.proguscommerce.com (management dashboard).

Privacy & Data:

  • On admin-initiated registration, plugin sends: site domain, admin email, optional page ID.
  • Front-end embeds use your site’s psl_id to render widgets; the plugin itself does not track users.
  • Privacy Policy: https://progus.com/pages/privacy
  • Terms of Service: https://progus.com/pages/terms

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/progus-store-locator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress “Plugins” screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress and then click “Settings”.
  3. Check the box to automatically create a new page with the store locator map embedded on your WordPress site (recommended). Then click “GET STARTED” — this will create your free Progus account and connect it to your site.
  4. After the setup is complete, click “Open Management Panel” to add and manage your store locations and customize your map.
  5. Add the store locator to any page or post using the shortcode [progus-store-locator] or the Gutenberg block.
sections.faq:
Is this a free plugin?

Yes, the plugin itself is free. However, it connects to the Progus Store Locator service which may have premium features available.

Do I need a Progus account?

The plugin automatically creates an account for you when activated, using your site’s domain and admin email.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, the store locator can be customized through the Progus service dashboard.

Is the store locator mobile-friendly?

Yes, the store locator is fully responsive and works on all devices.
